# PngCompressionLevel

[DotGame.Imaging](README.md) · `DotGame.Imaging.Png` · enum

```csharp
public enum PngCompressionLevel
```

How hard [`PngCodec.Encode`](PngCodec.md#encode) works to make a PNG file small: its members, and their order, are those of the runtime's `System.IO.Compression.CompressionLevel`.

## Values

| Value | Summary |
|---|---|
| <a name="optimal"></a>`Optimal` | A small file for the time it takes: the smallest color type that holds the pixels (RGB when every pixel is opaque, gray when every pixel is gray), and rows unfiltered or Paeth filtered, whichever a sample of them compresses smaller (unfiltered for flat-colored art, Paeth for photographs, gradients and most screenshots). For files that are kept or sent. |
| <a name="fastest"></a>`Fastest` | As fast as encoding goes: RGBA, unfiltered, compressed as quickly as deflate can. For files that are written and read again straight away, such as a build's intermediate images. |
| <a name="nocompression"></a>`NoCompression` | RGBA, unfiltered, and not compressed (deflate's stored blocks): the file is a little larger than the pixels. |
| <a name="smallestsize"></a>`SmallestSize` | The choices of [`Optimal`](#optimal), with deflate's slowest and smallest compression. |
